column1: # Every tool `agent-browser mcp --tools all` lists, classified against scripts/guard.sh.
# Checked by tests/mcp-catalog.mjs. Run it with --live after a version bump.
# Format: <tool without agent_browser_><TAB><own inputs, or -><TAB><guard status><TAB>word<TAB>word...
#   0 = allowed  ·  2 = deliberately forbidden  ·  10 = not in the allow-list
# The * row holds the inputs every tool shares; other rows leave them out.
